note: SCR-01D (Keen Dreams v1.93): a game: Space and Enter for a new game in normal mode (the Loading box, the Land of Tuberia), the status window on the map; the debug keys' windows (F10 with G, I, J, S, S, J, G: god mode, free items, jump cheat, slow motion on and off, each answered with N); F10+W, 1, Enter: the warp prompt, level 1 loaded; the status window there (99 of everything), Escape for the in-game control panel (the Loading box first; Escape opens it at Exit to DOS, with the warning that the game would be aborted), F5 the new game card (the warning again), 2 Resume Current Game and Enter back to the level.
